title: On advective nonlocal operators: multiplicity of principal eigenpairs
summary: We study the existence and multiplicity of principal eigenvalues and eigenfunctions for a periodically heterogeneous nonlocal dispersal model with advection. The operator we consider is resolvent-positive but not resolvent-compact; therefore, the classical Krein-Rutman theory cannot be applied directly. When the advection coefficient has a constant sign, we prove the existence and uniqueness of the principal eigenvalue and the corresponding normalized eigenfunction.
